response.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN l.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND l.product_price IS NOT NULL THEN l.derived_total_cost END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND l.product_price IS NOT NULL THEN l.product_price END), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM per_invoice) SELECT AVG(p.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(p.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM per_invoice AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio

assumptions.assumption: An invoice’s ratio is the sum of line total costs divided by the sum of unit prices, using lines where both values are present. Each invoice contributes equally to the final averages.

alternatives.interpretation: An invoice’s ratio is the average of its individual line total-cost-to-unit-price ratios.
